verdict.rationale: Financial Connections runs some work in the background on its own: refreshes complete asynchronously and emit webhook events for balance, ownership and transaction refreshes. Community evidence also mentions daily data pulls, and the docs list an agent use case for 'balance and transaction monitoring' via the Link CLI. Beyond that thin mention, there is no documented way for a user to configure autonomous background automations, so most of the story rests on developer building blocks. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or scheduling, documented autonomous agent workflows beyond a one-line use-case mention, and hands-on corroboration.
